summary: wellman check recognizes standard HOME and bundles worktree path checker

delivery.outcome: wellman check passes on the wellmanifest/new-project standard HOME and its bundled worktree overlap fallback can run in any Git checkout.
nonGoals: No change to adopter manifest or lock validation
No resync of other bundled checkers
No relaxation of worktree overlap findings

architecture.decision: Recognize the standard HOME only when .governance/manifest.json is absent and governance/manifest.hub.json names wellmanifest/new-project; validate its id/version without an adoption lock, as the bundled overlap checker already does. Ship new-project subprojects/worktrees/conformance.py as _bundled/worktree_path_check.py, the name its package manifest installs for adopters.
interfaceChanges: wellman check accepts the standard HOME hub manifest
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; adopters are unaffected.
